# Farmshare

> Farmshare is the coordination layer for independent meat processing in the United States. The platform provides online scheduling, digital cut sheets, customer communication, and invoicing for independent USDA-inspected and state-inspected plants, and connects those plants into a network that can reach markets none of them could reach alone.

## Company Facts

- Legal entity: Farmshare, Co., a Delaware corporation
- Headquarters: Denver, Colorado
- Founder and CEO: Henry Arrowood
- Network scale: 44 processing facilities across 27 states, serving 9,500 producers
- Website: https://farmshare.co

## Mission

Four companies control roughly 85% of beef processing in America. That advantage is not product quality. It is scale and intelligence: knowing what to buy, how to cut it, where to sell every piece, and at what price. Independent processors produce the quality and traceability consumers want, but they are fragmented and running blind, and only about 14 cents of every meat dollar makes it back to the producer.

Farmshare builds both halves for independents. Shared operating infrastructure gives them scale. Network data gives them the intelligence. The goal is thousands of independent processors collectively operating with the intelligence of a large packer, without any one of them needing to become one.

Read more: https://farmshare.co/mission

## What Farmshare Does

Farmshare helps independent custom meat processors modernize their operations. Farmers, ranchers, and hunters use Farmshare to:

- Find a local meat processor near them
- Book harvest slots online instead of calling
- Submit digital cut sheets from their phone
- Track order status with text and email updates

Processors use Farmshare to:

- Manage their scheduling calendar and capacity
- Collect cut sheet instructions digitally
- Communicate with customers automatically
- Reduce phone calls and paperwork

## Find a Processor

Farmshare maintains a directory of independent meat processors across the United States, covering both plants on the Farmshare network and plants that are not. Processors on the network offer online scheduling and digital cut sheets. Browse the directory, including per-state listings, at https://farmshare.co/find-a-processor

### Species Processed

Processors on the Farmshare network handle: Beef, Hog, Lamb, Goat, Bison, Venison, Veal, and Yak.

## Scheduling

To schedule a harvest appointment, visit https://partners.farmshare.co/scheduling and select a processor. You can view available dates, select your species and inspection level, and book directly online.
